name: Kick

maxWidth.note: 1080p60 hard max. Official page agrees: https://help.kick.com/en/articles/7066931-how-to-stream-on-kick-com Severity error because: Kick help: "KICK currently supports a maximum resolution of 1920x1080."; user reference: 1080p60 hard max.

maxHeight.note: Official page agrees: https://help.kick.com/en/articles/7066931-how-to-stream-on-kick-com Severity error because: Same as maxWidth.

portrait.note: Not stated on the page. Long/short side rule applies, so 1080x1920 is judged against 1920x1080.

maxFps.note: Official page agrees: https://help.kick.com/en/articles/7066931-how-to-stream-on-kick-com Severity error because: Kick help lists max 60 fps; user reference: 1080p60 hard max.

videoCodecs.note: H.264 only. Official page agrees: https://help.kick.com/en/articles/7066931-how-to-stream-on-kick-com Severity error because: Kick help: "KICK currently only supports X264 / H.264 encoding."

min.note: "1,000 kbps to 8,000 kbps" Severity error because: Kick help: settings range "1,000 kbps to 8,000 kbps".

max.note: Official page agrees: https://help.kick.com/en/articles/7066931-how-to-stream-on-kick-com Severity error because: Kick help: "KICK supports a bitrate of up to 8,000 kbps."; user reference: 8000 max.

protocols.note: Page example server uses RTMPS on port 443. Plain RTMP not documented.

max.note: Page: stereo at max 48 kHz; no audio bitrate stated.

audioTracksMax.note: Page says select "Stereo" only; track count not stated.

notes: Video ingest limits only. CBR required per the cited page.

rateControl.note: CBR only; VBR not supported. Official page agrees: https://help.kick.com/en/articles/7066931-how-to-stream-on-kick-com Severity error because: Kick help: "You must set your streaming software to CBR."; user reference: VBR not supported.

recommended.note: 48 kHz. Official page agrees: stereo at max 48 kHz: https://help.kick.com/en/articles/7066931-how-to-stream-on-kick-com

replyMaxChars.note: Post chat message: content limit 500 characters, and at most 2048 bytes in UTF-8 (official docs).
